title: crewai
summary: CrewAI is a framework for building, orchestrating, and managing autonomous AI agent teams. It enables developers to define agents with specific roles, goals, and tools, allowing them to collaborate on complex tasks. The system provides robust integrations with various Large Language Models and external tools, alongside features for project management, deployment, and advanced inter-agent communication.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Developer / User
nodes.description: The human user who interacts with the CrewAI system to define, run, and manage AI agent teams and their workflows.

nodes.label: CLI & Developer Tools
nodes.title: CLI & Developer Tools
nodes.description: Provides command-line interface and utilities for project setup, execution, deployment, and development tasks, streamlining the management of CrewAI projects.

nodes.label: Core AI Orchestration
nodes.title: Core AI Orchestration
nodes.description: The central engine for defining agents, tasks, and crews, managing their collaboration, and executing complex AI workflows. It integrates LLMs and handles task execution.

nodes.label: Agent Tools & Integrations
nodes.title: Agent Tools & Integrations
nodes.description: A comprehensive suite of tools that equip agents with abilities like web search, data scraping, RAG, and specialized API interactions, extending their capabilities to interact with the external world.

nodes.label: Data & RAG Management
nodes.title: Data & RAG Management
nodes.description: Manages data ingestion, processing, caching, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows, including vector store integrations, to provide agents with relevant knowledge.

nodes.label: A2A & Enterprise Features
nodes.title: A2A & Enterprise Features
nodes.description: Enables secure Agent-to-Agent communication, advanced authentication, and enterprise-grade features like evaluation and security controls for robust, scalable deployments.
